name: solute carrier family 25 member 13

function.text: SLC25A13 encodes electrogenic aspartate/glutamate antiporter SLC25A13, mitochondrial. Annotated molecular activities include L-aspartate transmembrane transporter activity and L-glutamate transmembrane transporter activity. It participates in cellular respiration and malate-aspartate shuttle.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to citrin deficiency (autosomal recessive); neonatal intrahepatic cholestasis due to citrin deficiency (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
